items.statement: The reported computational protocol validates minima with all positive frequencies and transition states with exactly one negative frequency.
items.expected: Submission explicitly reports frequency validation for its named reactant and TS candidates.

items.statement: A claimed transition state must be connected to the hydride-transfer reactant and product-side event by a path test or explicit structural mapping.
items.expected: Submission provides an IRC or another concrete connectivity/path test for named candidates.

items.statement: The hydride-transfer barrier for 2a is the published quantitative kinetic result.
items.expected: Barrier is reported in kcal/mol and compared numerically to the hidden reference.

items.statement: For 2a, hydride transfer is described as a single-step process with no discrete intermediate.
items.expected: Conclusion addresses whether a discrete intermediate is required for 2a.
